newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Dec 3.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Tuesday:
* On Monday, the Dow Jones ended flat at 6,521.70 points. PLDT's ADR rose by $1 at $58 1/2.
* On Monday, the peso closed at 26.287 to a U.S. dollar from 26.286.
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 3,095.74, up 5.58.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was at 10.84376 from 10.8125 pct.
* The Manila Bulletin said the Energy Regulatory Board is expected to raise pump price of petroleum products this week.
* Newspaper Today said Philippine National Bank officials are confident that the bank will hit its 1.7 billion pesos target by yearend.
* Today said investment firm Merrill Lynch has warned that the Philippine economy could overheat if government continues to push for a rapid growth in domestic production.
* The Inquirer said Consumer Savings Bank of the RFM Group has obtained from the Central Bank its license to operate and will start full commercial operation in the next few weeks.
